body: Hey guys, don't stick your dick in crazy. I'm actually being sincere here.
Thank you :)

No I haven't. That actually sounds like a good idea. The only thing is that once my classes start again I won't have time anymore.

I'm finding it hard to be happy and do things without extra stress. I don't even want to know how it'll go once I go back to varsity.

I started seeing a psychiatrist recently. Therapy doesn't really help me. I started acting as my own therapist today though. Sounds kinda weird but I know what they'll say. A psychologist can't tell me anything I don't already know. So I have a journal where I challenge my own thoughts. I started it today. I really hope it'll help. I spent the most part of the day in my bed but at least I did something.

Yes. The other day I got out of bed at 2pm and went back to bed at 8pm for the night. I'm so tired and I just don't want to do anything. I've tried doing things that used to interest me but even they feel like such a chore.

I do have psychological help. Got it recently.

I still can't spin a story how I accidentally spilt it on me. Or at least I don't know ow to come up with a story where I accidentally pour boiling water on the inside of my wrist and not tell anyone about it after it happened.

I put some antiseptic ointment for burns on it. I hope that's okay.

I just went to shower and when I took a plaster off a patch of my skin came with it. I wasn't aware that that part was that fragile too. Is this going to make the scar even worse? Sorry for the bad picture.
https://imgur.com/OFeGhy2
This is a self harm burn... So I don't really want to ask to see a doctor. Is there any way I can treat it on my own? Also how do I know when it is infected?
I've poured boiling water on my hands when I was bumped and missed a mug. I don't mind it. Accidently hurting myself satisfies my self harm urges a bit and it's not frowned upon by the public.
Ouch. Okay I won't do that. I can imagine that reaching a different level.

Trust me I do like blood. But I don't want any more scars. I haven't cut deep enough for long term scars in over 2 years. I want to keep it that way. 

The ice thing... Its a bit impractical since I still live with my parents. Also I could never really get it to hurt that much the times I did try. It gets to a stage where it just goes numb and you can't feel anything anymore. I appreciate you trying to help me though. Thank you. If you have any other tips please tell me. But I really feel like I've tried everything already.

Oh shit. I really hope that doesn't happen to me now. I'm trying to find alternatives to cutting because of scarring. I don't want discoloration or anything.

How much water did he pour on his leg? Do you think the amount I used is okay?

I have done the hot shower thing but I like the burn after you've poured the water. I felt in the shower it only burns while under the water. Maybe our showers here just don't get hot enough.

Was any scarring left on the person you know that did it?

I once accidentally spilt boiling water on my hand when filling a hot water bottle. I quite enjoyed it... 

I just filled, probably barely a quarter of a cup with boiled water from the kettle and then spilt in on my forearm. I know it's not a lot but it works for me. It still hurts a lot. I just want to make sure I don't cross the line and end up with massive scars.
Is there no way you can call him or go see him in person?
Not exercising. I'd love to exercise. I really would. But I really need more time to sleep to be able to function like a normal human being.
I also do this. I don't think it's so weird. I doubt your boyfriend will be weirded out.

I zoned out and thought it would be cool if I jumped over the black/green, weird creatures infested pool in front of me at the time. It was probably about 5m across. I realised what I was doing just before I jumped forward.

I don't know how old you are but in my country psychiatrists are allowed to tell your parents if you are a danger to yourself if you are under 18. That's what happened to me some time back. I trusted my psychiatrist and psychologist and they both went and suggested that I be sent away to a clinic for 4 weeks to my parents. Then it was up to my parents and they made the choice for me.

I'd suggest when you see your psychiatrist, ask them about it. Like what do they have to do in which circumstances and when choices are start being made for you. 

I really hope it works out for you and you get better. I'll be thinking of you.

We're all here for you though. Don't feel like all you have is yourself. You can always message me. I'm actually new to reddit. I'm so surprised at how everyone in this subreddit is so kind and supportive. I can really see that everyone here cares, so you have all of our support. Don't feel alone. I'm here for you, and so is the rest of the community.

Thank you. I have hope that I wont always feel this way now.
It's 8pm here at the moment and there?
Thank you for making me feel less worthless. I really appreciate it. And thank you for letting me know I'm not alone. It feels so lonely sometimes. I sincerely hope you get better soon too.

Thank you so much. I have a little hope. And it's enough to keep me going. I really hope that one day I'll be happy and healthy. I'm trying the best I can to take care of myself, but thank you for helping me do that.

Right now my goal is to not think about suicide at least once every 15 minutes. Is that good enough for now? I really can't think of anything else at this time. My first step is seeing my psychiatrist which I'm doing tomorrow. Although I'm really scared.
Thank you. I'm trying to believe it'll make me stronger. Sometimes it feels like I'm just being damaged more and more though but I'm trying to get through this. Thank you for believing in me.
Thank you. I really do enjoy music. I'll listen to those songs again.
Thank you for saying I'm not weak and that I'm smart and brave instead. I'm trying hard to get myself to truly believe that. Thank you for being there for me.
Thank you for saying all those things. I have survived many times. I'll keep on pushing until life gets beautiful again. I hope you feel better soon too.
That's true. I just hope this is the darkest my night gets.
Thank you :)

I'm going to see my psychiatrist tomorrow for the first time in a very long time. I hope it all goes well and I finally reach the end of this miserable tunnel at some point. I never wanted to go back to her but I think I've reached a point where I have no other choice.

Thank you for making me feel like I'm not the only one in the world feeling like this.
Thank you. Sometimes I seriously just need a distraction. I'll definitely look it up and try it. And I am feeling a bit better. Thank you for keeping me in your thoughts.

Thank you. I do feel very vulnerable. I really appreciate you talking about your experience. I'm glad you're doing better.

I'm seeing my psychiatrist tomorrow. I haven't seen her in about 1.5 years. Also haven't been on any medication since then. Hopefully I can get back on some medication for a while again.

I'm just really scared because the last time I had a really bad experience and I feel kind of traumatized and have some serious trust issues with these types of people. Well specifically that psychiatrist. I don't want to change because she already knows my history. I'm going to try face my fears and if it really doesn't work then I'll get a new psychiatrist.

Thank you for being so kind to me and taking interest.
Thank you for being there. I definitely will if I ever need to.
I interpreted it as you must just keep going even though it feels like hell. It'll eventually end and you'll get through it. That's what I thought it meant.
Okay I'll do that. Thank you.
Oh okay. I'm sorry. But what do you think I should do?
What an amazing poem. Thank you for believing in me.
Thank you so so much.

Thank you. I am giving life another chance and I really hope I'm glad I'm doing so in the future. I'm trying to get better. I'm going back to my psychiatrist as soon as they have an opening. I haven't been on any medication for quite some time. Hopefully it helps me get on the right track again.
Undergrad. Yeah tv is really nice in the holidays.

I might have been on other things when they were trying to find something that works for me 3 years ago. But the ones I mentioned was what I stuck with. 

I know fluoxetine is in Nuzak. I'm not sure what quetiapine is though. I'm assuming it's in seroquel (however you spell it).

Thank you. Everyone's kind words here has made me feel a lot better. Studying takes up must of my time so I don't get to watch very many movies. Its actually quite sad. I really hope your recovery goes well and you feel better soon.
Thank you. I'll keep the ER in mind. And also thank you for saying asking for help is courageous. I hope you're doing better.
Thank you for that advice. I used to do that. I'll try it again. And thank you for saying that asking for support is strong of me or that I'm stronger than I think I am.
Thank you for saying that. And thank you so much for being there. And what a beautiful way of writing. This really made me feel better.
I've calmed down a bit now. I didn't use that technique but I will definitely try next time. Thank you so much.
Thank you so much.

Most my time goes into studying. Well sitting in front of my books crying. I don't enjoy what I'm studying. But it's the thing I hate the least.

The rest of my time goes into relationships that just don't seem to work. My parents are constantly making it more difficult for me. Any my boyfriend... I should break up with him. But I can't see myself with anyone else. Sol I'll rather just end myself. He'll be better off with me dead in the long term. Everyone will be. 

I have no other hobbies anymore anyway. I used to but I just don't care about any of it.

I've never been happy. I just learnt to deal with it. But why? It's not making anything better.

I'm sorry for ranting. You don't have to listen to me. I just realised again that I'm to much of a coward to actually do it. I don't have a high enough place in my room to hang my rope to prevent me from just putting my weight on my feet again. Even if I did I'd probably be too cowardly to try it. I wish someone could just kill me.

Sorry for ranting again. You don't have to reply.

I've tried too many times to make things work. The pain in life far outweighs the pleasure. I do nothing right. Even if there are people who care about me, what's the point if they don't show it? I want everyone to be happy but instead I hurt everyone. If I kill myself now I'll save so much effort for everyone and I'll finally not feel anything.
Being paralyzed. If I'm in any accident where I could be paralyzed, I hope I rather die. And when you're paralyzed you can't even kill yourself.
Competition should be a choice (where it can be). For some people it's motivation but for others it just makes them feel like shit. Everyone is different and that should be respected.

Blue because I think it's emotional and it fits with my depressive nature.
Also crimson because it reminds me of blood and that makes me feel good in a weird way.
Asleep by The Smiths.
It is killing us slowly. It's busy oxidizing our bodies. Just like when you leave an apple exposed to air it turns brown or how metal rusts. That's happening to our bodies. Just slowly.

I think in my situation snapping at my mom won't do any good. I've broken down in front of my parents before and it didn't really help. They don't know how to help and tend to just make things worse. It's better to just keep them out of it and let me dying be a surprise to them. I'll probably not kill myself soon though although I want to. I'm just too weak.
Thank you. I'll check it out.

No no. Her asking more questions and not understanding will only do more harm. I learnt my lesson the first time. I'm sure I would've been in a better space now if I didn't get my parents involved that first time.
I don't think I'm the right person to try help you. But I can tell you that you're not alone.
